purpose: Provide Core 1.4 a stable, auditable input contract for Billy Walters-derived handicapping intelligence without granting that layer automatic fair-value, independent-signal, status, playTo, staking or execution authority.

sourceAuthority.primaryMethodSource: Billy Walters, Gambler, Chapters 21 and 22, using approved structured summaries and user-supplied source material rather than repository-stored unauthorized full chapter text
sourceAuthority.page270Rule: Spread-versus-moneyline conversion must use the corrected, internally reconciled source logic. If the approved correction cannot be resolved, return SPREAD_VS_ML_UNAVAILABLE rather than infer or reconstruct from an inconsistent historical chart.

coverage.futureExpansion: Other sports/markets may use the same interface only after their Walters methodology mapping is explicitly defined and tested.
coverage.meaning: Core 1.4 must know whether Walters intelligence is AVAILABLE, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE for an eligible candidate. Missing Walters data does not block an otherwise valid Betting Edge report.

source.sourceAsOf: timestamp/date through which the Walters inputs are current
source.sourceRefs: array of provenance references for power ratings, personnel, game factors and any conversion tables used

power.rawHomeDifferential: number|null; home rating minus away rating

personnel.adjustments: array of {participant, player, position, participation, effectiveness, pointImpact, replacementQuality, clusterImpact, uncertainty, sourceRefs}
personnel.unresolved: array of material unresolved player/position-group questions

gameFactors.factors: array of {factor, adjustment, state, rationale, sourceRefs}; adjustment uses home-positive point convention; state is APPLIED|NO_ADJUSTMENT|INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

fairSpread.homePerspective: number|null; negative means home favorite, positive means home underdog
fairSpread.componentEquation: human-readable rating + home field + personnel + factors path

keyNumbers.crossings: array of material NFL key-number crossings between Walters fair and market reference
keyNumbers.tableRef: provenance reference to the current calibrated key-number table when used

spreadVsMoneyline.logicRef: provenance reference to corrected conversion logic

marketReference.rule: This is comparison context only. Core 1.4 obtains executable identity/price/freshness from the normal Betting Edge feed and gates.

coreComparison.materialityRationale: why the agreement/disagreement is or is not material, including key-number context

initialCore14Use.reReviewMeaning: Re-open current evidence and model assumptions. Any resulting fair-value change must be justified by explicit current-model/current-evidence reasoning rather than Walters disagreement alone.
initialCore14Use.futureCalibrationDataValue: Preserve Walters projections and comparison state so later approved CLV/result work can evaluate whether/how Walters deserves quantitative weight. Results/CLV learning itself is not part of Core 1.4.

futureActivationBoundary.promotionRequirement: Any future change that lets Walters directly move fair value, lower model error, count as independent support, set playTo or influence stake requires a separately versioned activation, calibration evidence, regression testing and explicit approval.
